Loop 103 — SHORT minimal-port exact-head binding task.

Goal:
Add only the smallest pure binding between a result PR head SHA and a GitHub workflow-run head SHA, reusing the existing observed workflow status mapper. Do not design a full PR/check observation subsystem.

Upstream / accepted source:
- .github/workflows/loop-status-development.yml already reads PR .head.sha directly from GitHub.

Small component to reuse:
Exact equality of the observed PR head SHA and observed workflow-run head SHA, then delegate to the existing map_github_workflow_run_to_observed_check().

Existing local destination:
- automation/command_bus/signal_observed_github.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_signal_observed_github.py

Allowed changed paths — EXACTLY these two files.

map_exact_head_github_run_to_observed_check(pr_head_sha, run_head_sha, status, conclusion)

- no network/file/GitHub calls
- both head values must be strings matching exactly 40 lowercase hex characters

- matching valid head + queued -> VERIFYING
- matching valid head + in_progress -> VERIFYING

- matching valid head + completed/failure -> FAIL
- mismatched valid heads -> UNKNOWN
- malformed/missing/uppercase/short/non-string heads -> UNKNOWN
